prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Morning light breaks through parting clouds over the still flood water and the bare rocky top of a mountain, mist lifting slowly off the slopes, a lone rock ledge in the centre of the frame. Dawn, golden light after rain. Hushed and hopeful. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No boats, no people, no text, no logos.
